status.description: UNMANNED: no steward yet. PENDING: a steward has reported a position for the station and is on the way. MANNED: the steward has arrived. TASK_DONE: the steward has finished the task (a position report with taskDone, MET-A-015). Allowed transitions: UNMANNED -> PENDING (a position report for the station), PENDING -> MANNED (the steward arrives), PENDING or MANNED -> TASK_DONE (taskDone at the station of the steward's latest report). Any other change is rejected with E1006.

staff.description: The userId of the steward who reported to this station, the same id GET /api/v1/me and the login token return, written as text (for example "1"). Null when nobody has reported.
